standard_prerequisites.name: The lisse-etale and flat-fppf morphisms of topoi
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Cohomology of Algebraic Stacks, Lemma stacks-cohomology-lemma-lisse-etale
standard_prerequisites.use: g^* = g^{-1} and g^{-1}g_! = id on sheaves.

standard_prerequisites.name: Parasitic detection on the sites
standard_prerequisites.use: g^* of a parasitic module is zero.

core_obligations: g^{-1} preserves qc (local-pullback plus characterize-bis) and g_! preserves qc (shriek-quasi-coherent); H -> g^{-1}g_!H iso by the lisse-etale lemma (proof lines 3619-3631).

g_!g^{-1}F -> F is a map of qc modules iso after restriction to every smooth (resp. flat) scheme; the presentation-comparison discussion in Sheaves on Stacks concludes it is an isomorphism (proof lines 3632-3640).

(b): kernel and cokernel of Q(F) -> F are parasitic (adjoint-kernel-parasitic), so g^* kills them by parasitic-in-terms-flat-fppf and exactness of g^*, giving g^*F in QCoh; (c) from (b) (proof lines 3643-3655).
proof_roadmap: Show both functors preserve qc and one adjunction is an iso.
Conclude the other adjunction via the presentation comparison and Q-parasitic mechanism.
difficulty_reason: Both sites are treated by the same four-step argument: g^{-1} and g_! preserve qc (cited), H -> g^{-1}g_!H is an isomorphism (lisse-etale lemma), the reverse adjunction map is a map of qc modules isomorphic on every smooth (flat) scheme hence an isomorphism by the presentation-comparison discussion, and (b)/(c) follow from parasitic kernels and cokernels of the Q-adjunction.
